create_embodied_task: create a custom EmbodiedTask subclass that defines action space, observations, and measures for a navigation task
implement_action_step: implement the step method of an Action subclass to perform a movement and return observations
build_measure_class: build a Measure subclass with reset_metric and update_metric methods to track navigation distance
use_measurements_reset: use Measurements.reset_measures to reset all measure metrics at the start of a new episode
check_episode_active: check the is_episode_active property of EmbodiedTask to determine if the current episode should continue
